data.body: Follow-up change 3535 merged as 35c1983cb07 at 06:27 PST 2026-11-23 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved). make verify before push: 21912 passed / 34 skipped default tier, 231 passed / 2 skipped integration tier. Its LLM-Review raised one more operator-notice gap: generator or SSM failure after the token delete exits without the 'already replaced' notice. It is filed as wary-unmindful-ibisbill (discovered_from this ticket); it does not put a credential on a command line, so it is outside this ticket's criteria. All 3 acceptance criteria met: service-user.sh keeps the token out of every argv (stub-recorded); AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md use curl --config - from a pipe; the amurminnow static guard covers the listed files and passes.
